text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ines-san, you've been working your 
part-time jobs... every single day lately, 
haven't you? Are you not exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for worrying about me, Ikuno-chan! 
But today's my day off. Because it's an 
important day, you know!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An important day... What a coincidence. 
Today is an important one for me, too—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's my birthdaaaay! Did you already get 
your party invitation?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Could that invitation stuck to the 
door have been from Ines-san?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep, made by yours truly♪ Though Ryan-chan 
was the one who put it on the door.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we all prepared a huge feast and 
presents for today~♪ Look forward to it, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Um, could it be... you didn't take on 
extra part-time shifts just for my 
birthday, did you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nope, that's not it~. Working a part-time 
job is always for my own sake. It's for 
that happy, fun, joyful feeling!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ines-san. Thank you. In that case, 
there is only one thing I must do."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will spend today to the fullest, and 
savor every bit of joy, fun, and 
happiness!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The nutritional value of the meal, 
impressions on the flavor. Gratitude for 
the present, recovery of energy gained 
from joy—I shall compile all of it into a 
report—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's okay. Just looking at your 
face tells me everything you're feeling, 
Ikuno-chan!
